error_codes.name: Compass Error
error_codes.description: Compass calibration failed or sensor error detected
resolution_steps: Move drone away from magnetic interference sources

error_codes.name: Compass Interference
error_codes.description: Magnetic field interference detected near drone
resolution_steps: Move to a location away from power lines and metal structures
Wait 30 seconds for magnetic field to stabilize

error_codes.name: IMU Error
resolution_steps: Ensure drone is on a level surface
Perform IMU calibration using DJI Fly app
